component.name: GMAT
component.summary: General Mission Analysis Tool for space mission design and optimization

description.p: GMAT (General Mission Analysis Tool) is an open-source space mission design, optimization, and navigation tool developed by NASA. It is used for real-world mission operations and advanced research across the full mission lifecycle.

ul.li: High-fidelity orbit propagation with multiple force models
Lunar, interplanetary, and libration point mission design
Targeting and optimization via differential correction and NLP solvers
SPICE kernel support via NAIF CSPICE

screenshot.caption: GMAT main window with mission sequence and resource tree

description.p: GMAT R2026a release with updated Python interface (3.12), new MSISE-00 atmosphere model plugin, and OpenFrames R2025a visualization update.
